For e.g., fly ash is a common strategy to reduce carbon footprint, substituting the traditional material used in concrete with non-virgin or industrial by- products. Textile Reinforced Concrete (TRC) uses technical textiles in place of steel for reinforcement, which reduces the embodied carbon (of reinforcement material) from 2.55 metric tons CO2e/kg to ~2.2 kgCO2e/kg.
